# CLIENT BRIEF — LINE UP SURF HOUSE, ANZA (verbatim intent from the client; binding; do not edit)

## Absolute rule
DO NOT MAKE HYLE SURFHOUSE AGAIN. Peashoot already built a highly personal Simo-centred surfhouse site (https://hyle-surfhouse.peashoot.io/ — local copy /tmp/sites/hyle-surfhouse). Line Up must have a clearly different creative identity. Hyle was warm/intimate/host-driven.

## Core idea
Public evidence suggests Line Up's strongest themes are: extremely close to Anza Beach · surf · rooftop / sea views · breakfast · family-run hospitality · extremely strong staff ratings · guests being helped with local logistics · surf instruction/equipment.

The creative concept should revolve around: **the rhythm of a day by the break.** Wake up. Check the ocean. Breakfast. Surf. Come home. Eat. Go again. Watch the sunset from the roof. Make the website feel like living a day at Line Up.

## Current public baseline (research and verify)
- Line Up Surf House · address around: NR 33 Projet Social Anza, Agadir · essentially steps from Anza Beach
- Booking rating around 9.6, around 200 Booking reviews · staff near 10.0 · value around 9.8
- sea-view rooms · rooftop / terrace · free Wi-Fi · free parking · vegetarian / halal breakfast · private/shared bathroom arrangements depending on room · family-friendly accommodation
- Reviews repeatedly reference a family-run environment. Names publicly mentioned: Said, Zouhair — review descriptions suggest Said helps guests with taxis, activities, food and logistics; Zouhair teaches surfing; parents/family help prepare breakfast; traditional meals may sometimes be available; surf lessons; equipment rental; rooftop meals / ocean view.

IMPORTANT: these roles are partly review-derived. INDEPENDENTLY VERIFY before converting them into permanent biographies. If not fully verifiable, say something like "Guests regularly describe Line Up as a genuinely family-run place" (in brand voice, never research voice) rather than inventing formal job titles.

## Creative concept
Use the actual surfing meaning of **LINE UP**: the line-up is where surfers sit waiting for waves. This gives a distinctive visual system. Possible design language: horizontal swell lines · tide-chart-inspired geometry · horizon lines · wave sets · sequences · rhythm · sunrise-to-sunset progression.
DO NOT make up live swell data. Do not pretend to have a surf forecast API. Use the visual LANGUAGE, not fake data.

## Homepage as a day
Explore making the homepage progress through a day, conceptually: MORNING (breakfast / rooftop / first look at the ocean) → FIRST SESSION (walk to Anza break) → MIDDAY (eat / rest / explore) → SECOND SESSION (back in the water) → SUNSET (roof / ocean / people). Only make factual service statements that are verified. The timeline itself can be storytelling rather than pretending there are scheduled events every day.

## Content (potential architecture)
Home · Stay · Surf · The House · The Rooftop · Anza · Reviews · Book. Maybe better ideas emerge. Do not force unnecessary pages.

## Surf
Research exactly what Line Up itself offers: lessons? instructors? equipment? rental? beginner coaching? transport to other breaks? packages? Do NOT import generic surfhouse features. If Zouhair truly teaches guests and this can be verified, that could become a meaningful human component.

## Food
Breakfast gets strong public mentions — treat it visually. If traditional lunches/tajines are genuinely an available service, this could be excellent content. If they were only one-off acts of hospitality described in reviews, do not advertise a restaurant that doesn't exist.

## Rooftop
If public photography supports it, make the rooftop a major spatial element. It can anchor: breakfast · view · relaxation · social atmosphere · sunset.

## Reviews
The staff score appears exceptional — a major trust signal. Do not spam the number. Use the human story behind it. Recurring themes: family feeling · helpfulness · cleanliness · surfing · food · location · value. Real attributable quotes only when appropriate.

## Booking
Simple and believable: dates · number of guests · room · surf lessons? · equipment? · airport transfer? · WhatsApp · message. Only offer optional items that are verified. Booking.com can remain as fallback if appropriate.

## Visual direction
Fresh Atlantic surf editorial. NOT Hyle. Line Up should be: rhythmic · graphic · ocean-oriented · energetic · clean · more surf-publication-like. Use the name as a design idea.
Avoid generic surf clichés: giant turquoise gradient · palm tree icons · random surfboard SVGs · "good vibes only". Real Anza. Real surf. Real house. Real people.
Make the site feel like: **this is where you stay when surfing is the reason you're in Agadir.**

## Cross-site test
Line Up must feel like **the rhythm of surfing and staying beside the break** — clearly different from Hala Tours (a local world of experiences), Hôtel Lynx (practical urban hospitality) and Hyle.

## Owner embarrassment test
Would Line Up say "Zouhair doesn't do that / that's not our service"? Fix anything uncertain.
